row:
Whether it’s pain, fatigue, poor posture, stress or anxiety, we all have an ailment that makes day to day life that little bit more difficult. I'll be sharing videos with tips to help keep you injury and pain free. 

I’ve been a massage therapist since 2012 and I’ve learnt that people rarely suffer from one isolated problem. I treat everyone who comes to me as an individual and I find out what is happening to them and, more importantly, why. It’s only then that we’ll be able to find the best therapy to help. Massage therapy is about making you feel better as a whole, enhancing your overall health and well-being.
 
I began my BTEC Level 5 qualification with the Oxford School of Sports Massage in 2011. I have been practicing since I qualified in 2012, and now have a great deal of experience to add to that. I also have a Level 3 Personal Training and Level 3 Exercise Referral qualifications and I’m a Sivananda Yoga Teacher CYT 200.
